name: X.J. Electrics (Hu Bei) Co., Ltd
summary: X.J. Electrics (Hu Bei) Co., Ltd was set up in 2012 and is headquartered in Shenzhen. It researches, designs, manufactures and sells household products, both electric and non-electric. The electric range covers heating appliances like griddles, air fryers and kettles, motorized blenders, mixers and can openers, and small electronics including digital scales, humidifiers and laser projector lights, while the non-electric side offers garden hoses and cookware.
